notice.title: Do not borrow Bến Thành’s clock
notice.body: No hour and no fee for this hall were printed. The split clock and the free line on the national attractions page are about Bến Thành, not this market.

body: The southern page calls Chợ Lớn the Chinese neighborhood and says to walk it, with Bình Tây as the wholesale center. The photograph is the gate: the clock and the words Chợ Bình Tây. A street number is Check on arrival.

The second photograph is the interior, stairs and the wholesale floor. It is not the gate. The unnamed food street Vietnam Tourism places in District 5 is a different entry, because the street’s name is not printed.
